about: Hand-labelled claims for the hallucination detector (services/api/eval/eval_grounding.py). Each case is a question - its evidence is what retrieval gives it (the top passages, as the chat would see them) - and claims labelled by hand: `supported` true when that evidence says it, often in other words; false when it is invented, swapped or contradicted. The supported paraphrases measure the detector's false alarms; the rest its misses. Keep the claims out of docs/ (tests/test_docs_corpus.py checks that no evaluation question is quoted there).

cases.q: how is the health index of a part calculated?

claims.text: The health index is the share of the margin to failure that remains, from 100 for a new part to 0 for one failing now.
A part that has already failed shows a health index of 0.
The health index is averaged over the last ten orders before it is shown.
Parts with a health index under 50 are replaced automatically by the robot.

cases.q: how does the guest session cookie work?

claims.text: Until sign-in arrives every visitor is a guest, issued by the server on the browser's first request to the API.
The browser keeps the guest in a cookie.
The guest cookie expires after 24 hours and the guest is then deleted from the database.
Each guest has to confirm an email address before the cookie is issued.

cases.q: what parts and connections does the edge computer have?

claims.text: The edge PC has no fan: its finned aluminium lid works as the heat sink.
One Ethernet port goes to the cabinet's switch and the other to the site network.
The edge PC carries a 512 GB NVMe drive and a graphics card for the vision model.
The edge computer is powered by 230 V AC from a wall socket.

cases.q: what are the drag chains on the moving axes?

claims.text: Drag chains carry the moving cables for the crane's travel and lift and the robot's plunge and reach.
The drag chains are steel links that are greased every week.
The robot's cables hang freely from the ceiling instead of riding in a chain.

cases.q: how does the twin see a part failing before it breaks?

claims.text: The pre-failure window opens when the chance of a failure within 90 orders reaches the threshold for three orders running.
The pre-failure window opens when the failure probability stays above the threshold for twelve orders running.
The warning reaches the maintenance team as a text message on their phones.

cases.q: what does the normal-behaviour model in predictive maintenance do?

claims.text: Before anything else, the effect of the hall temperature on signals such as belt slip is taken out.
The normal-behaviour model is a random forest trained on vibration spectra from accelerometers.

cases.q: what does the colour sensor measure in millivolts?

claims.text: The colour sensor gives a brightness reading as a voltage, not a colour.
The sensor is an RGB sensor that compares its red and green channels.
The sensor is recalibrated by the operator before every shift.

cases.q: what is the difference between the real factory and this twin?

claims.text: The vacuum gripper robot is a gantry arm carrying a mould and its cup of dough between the warehouse belt, the oven and the sorting line.
The real factory uses a six-axis articulated arm where the twin has a gantry.

cases.q: who decides whether a question is answered from the documents or the web?

claims.text: When the first model is busy or offline the next one takes over on its own.
An operator must approve each web search before it is run.

cases.q: how is the factory's carbon footprint computed per cookie?

claims.text: The page shows the grams per cookie for each day, coloured by the weather.
Carbon per cookie uses a fixed grid factor of 400 g for every kilowatt-hour.

cases.q: how do the inspection camera photos reach the server?

claims.text: Photo capture can be switched off with a setting.
The photos are sent to the server by email once a day.

cases.q: what error code does the API return when the daily question budget is spent?

claims.text: A service the API depends on that does not answer gives a 504.
A spent budget makes the API answer with status 418.
